AC-6 (14): .wl-badge has exactly the six declarations

AC-7 (16): no hex or rgb/hsl function in wlBadge.css, wlBadge.mjs, test/web/**
AC-7 (17): every color/background value is exactly var(--…)
AC-7 (18): no @import in wlBadge.css
AC-7 (19, QA): git diff main -- web/tokens.css is empty
AC-8 (20, QA): contrast of --on-wl on each --wl-N >= 4.5 from tokens.css at runtime
AC-9 (21, QA): package.json has no dependencies/devDependencies
